blocks.zh: §312.23：IND 申請內容：CMC 規格章節與製造要求
blocks.en: §312.23: IND Content and Format: CMC Specification Section and Manufacturing Requirements

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋主題 Topics Covered
blocks.en: Topics Covered

blocks.zh: 學習目標 2.1 IND 整體格式 §312.23(a) 2.2 原料藥 CMC §312.23(a)(7)(i) 2.3 製劑 CMC §312.23(a)(7)(ii) 2.4 Phase 適當性深度 2.5 CMC 修訂申報 2.6 無菌注射劑額外要求 2.7 FDA 查廠權利 章節摘要
blocks.en: Learning Objectives 2.1 Overall IND Format §312.23(a) 2.2 Drug Substance CMC §312.23(a)(7)(i) 2.3 Drug Product CMC §312.23(a)(7)(ii) 2.4 Phase-Appropriate Depth 2.5 CMC Amendments 2.6 Additional Requirements for Sterile Injectables 2.7 FDA Right to Inspect Section Summary

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 列舉 §312.23(a) IND 申請的 10 大元素，並識別 CMC 章節（元素 7）作為 CDMO 核心貢獻的法規位置與要求。
blocks.en: List the 10 elements of an IND application under §312.23(a), and identify the CMC section (element 7) as the CDMO's core contribution, including its regulatory location and requirements.

blocks.zh: 區分原料藥（Drug Substance）與製劑（Drug Product）CMC 各自需涵蓋的必要項目，並說明無菌注射劑的額外特殊要求（內毒素、無菌、微粒）。
blocks.en: Distinguish the required items that the CMC for the Drug Substance and the CMC for the Drug Product must each cover, and explain the additional requirements specific to sterile injectables (endotoxin, sterility, particulates).

blocks.zh: 對應臨床階段（Phase 1/2/3），說明 CMC 文件深度的 Phase-Appropriate 原則，並理解各階段在製程驗證、方法驗證、穩定性資料上的要求差異。
blocks.en: Explain the phase-appropriate principle for the depth of CMC documentation across the clinical phases (Phase 1/2/3), and understand how requirements for process validation, method validation and stability data differ at each phase.

blocks.zh: 判斷 CMC 變更屬於 Protocol Amendment、Information Amendment 或 Annual Report 範疇，並說明各類申報的時效要求。
blocks.en: Determine whether a CMC change falls under a Protocol Amendment, an Information Amendment or the Annual Report, and explain the timing requirements for each type of submission.

blocks.zh: 計算靜脈注射製品的內毒素限度（K/M 公式），並說明 CDMO 在 FDA 查廠義務中的角色。
blocks.en: Calculate the endotoxin limit for an intravenous product (K/M formula) and explain the CDMO's role in FDA inspection obligations.

blocks.zh: 2.1 Overall IND Format — §312.23(a) IND 申請整體格式
blocks.en: 2.1 Overall IND Format - §312.23(a)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CMC 章節是 CDMO 的主戰場
blocks.en: Core Concept: The CMC Section Is the CDMO's Main Arena

blocks.zh: 10 個 IND 元素中，絕大多數由 Sponsor 的臨床、藥理、毒理團隊負責。CMC 章節（§312.23(a)(7)，即第 6 個內容元素）是 CDMO 對 IND 的核心貢獻，直接決定：
blocks.en: Of the 10 IND elements, the vast majority are the responsibility of the Sponsor's clinical, pharmacology and toxicology teams. The CMC section (§312.23(a)(7), the 6th content element) is the CDMO's core contribution to the IND and directly determines:

blocks.zh: FDA 是否對製造安全性有顧慮而發 Clinical Hold（30 天暫停令）
blocks.en: Whether FDA has concerns about manufacturing safety and issues a Clinical Hold (a 30-day stop order)

blocks.zh: 試驗藥物批次能否符合放行標準供臨床使用
blocks.en: Whether investigational drug batches can meet release criteria for clinical use

blocks.zh: 製造變更是否需要事先通知 FDA
blocks.en: Whether a manufacturing change requires advance notification to FDA

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常以 CMC Disclosure Package 的形式提供資料，由 Sponsor 整合進 IND 申請書中。CDMO 的資料正確性與完整性由 Sponsor 對 FDA 負最終責任，但 CDMO 的實際製造行為（文件、記錄、製程）直接面對 FDA 查廠。
blocks.en: A CDMO usually provides its information in the form of a CMC Disclosure Package, which the Sponsor integrates into the IND application. The Sponsor bears ultimate responsibility to FDA for the accuracy and completeness of the CDMO's data, but the CDMO's actual manufacturing practices (documents, records, processes) face FDA inspection directly.

blocks.zh: IND 數字混淆提醒
blocks.en: A Reminder on IND Numbering Confusion

blocks.zh: §312.23(a) 法規條文將 CMC 稱為第 7 個子項目 (a)(7)，但在 IND 申請書的慣例順序中，它通常被稱為「第 6 個元素」（因為 Cover Sheet 和 TOC 是行政格式，有時不計入實質科學內容計數）。考試或審查情境中，認識 §312.23(a)(7) 這個 CFR 引用號碼最為關鍵。
blocks.en: The text of §312.23(a) labels CMC as the 7th sub-item (a)(7), but in the customary ordering of an IND application it is usually called the "6th element" (because the Cover Sheet and TOC are administrative formats and are sometimes not counted among the substantive scientific content). In an exam or review context, knowing the CFR citation §312.23(a)(7) is what matters most.

blocks.zh: 30 天 Clinical Hold 與 CMC 的關係
blocks.en: The 30-Day Clinical Hold and CMC

blocks.zh: FDA 收到 IND 申請後有 30 天審查期。若 CMC 章節資料不足，FDA 可依 §312.42 發出 Clinical Hold，禁止臨床試驗啟動。常見 CMC 觸發原因：
blocks.en: After receiving an IND application, FDA has a 30-day review period. If the data in the CMC section are insufficient, FDA may issue a Clinical Hold under §312.42, prohibiting the clinical trial from starting. Common CMC triggers include:

blocks.zh: 無菌保證方法描述不清
blocks.en: An unclear description of the sterility assurance method

blocks.zh: 雜質超標或缺乏毒理學評估
blocks.en: Impurities above limits or lacking toxicological evaluation

blocks.zh: 穩定性資料不足以支撐試驗期間的使用期效
blocks.en: Stability data insufficient to support the use period during the trial

blocks.zh: 容器相容性資料缺失（尤其蛋白質藥物）
blocks.en: Missing container compatibility data (especially for protein drugs)

blocks.zh: 2.2 Drug Substance CMC Requirements — §312.23(a)(7)(i) 原料藥 CMC 要求
blocks.en: 2.2 Drug Substance CMC Requirements - §312.23(a)(7)(i)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Drug Substance vs. Drug Product 的界線
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Boundary Between Drug Substance and Drug Product

blocks.zh: Drug Substance（原料藥 / API）是藥物的活性成分本身，尚未製成最終劑型。例如：
blocks.en: The Drug Substance (API) is the active ingredient of the drug itself, not yet made into the final dosage form. For example:

blocks.zh: 小分子藥：合成後、精製後的化學原體（bulk API）
blocks.en: Small-molecule drugs: the chemical entity after synthesis and purification (bulk API)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥：純化後的 Bulk Drug Substance（BDS），儲存於 -80°C 凍存袋
blocks.en: Protein drugs: purified Bulk Drug Substance (BDS), stored in -80°C freezer bags

blocks.zh: mRNA 藥：製備後的 mRNA 原液（未包覆 LNP 前）
blocks.en: mRNA drugs: the mRNA solution after preparation (before LNP encapsulation)

blocks.zh: Drug Product（製劑 / 成品）是加入賦形劑、經製程（無菌灌裝、凍乾等）後的最終臨床使用劑型。兩者的 CMC 提交分屬不同子節，對應不同的製造場地與製程控制要求。
blocks.en: The Drug Product is the final dosage form used clinically, after excipients are added and the product has been through processing (aseptic filling, lyophilization, etc.). The CMC submissions for the two fall under different subsections and correspond to different manufacturing sites and process control requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻：原料藥的 CMC 就像食材規格書
blocks.en: Analogy: Drug Substance CMC Is Like an Ingredient Specification Sheet

blocks.zh: 原料藥的 CMC 就像餐廳對食材供應商要求的「食材驗收規格書」：必須說明來源（哪個農場/合成廠）、製備方式（有機耕種/合成路徑）、品質指標（農藥殘留/雜質限度）、儲存方式（冷鏈/防潮容器）。Phase 1 時，規格書可以粗略一些（食材還在試用期）；Phase 3 時，每一個項目都必須有充分數據支撐，如同商業供應合約。
blocks.en: Drug substance CMC is like the "ingredient acceptance specification" a restaurant requires of its ingredient suppliers: it must state the source (which farm/synthesis plant), the method of preparation (organic farming/synthetic route), the quality indicators (pesticide residues/impurity limits) and the storage method (cold chain/moisture-proof container). In Phase 1 the specification can be rough (the ingredient is still on trial); in Phase 3 every item must be backed by sufficient data, like a commercial supply contract.

blocks.zh: 常見的 FDA 483 觸發點：雜質控制
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 Trigger: Impurity Control

blocks.zh: 藥物雜質控制是 CMC 審查的高風險區域。CDMO 需特別注意：
blocks.en: Control of drug impurities is a high-risk area in CMC review. A CDMO should pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 基因毒性雜質（ICH M7）：需進行 DEREK/Sarah 計算毒性評估；Phase 1 可採用 TTC（Threshold of Toxicological Concern）方法設限
blocks.en: Genotoxic impurities (ICH M7): a toxicity assessment using DEREK/Sarah calculations is needed; in Phase 1 the TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) approach can be used to set limits

blocks.zh: 殘留溶劑（ICH Q3C）：必須列出所有合成步驟使用的溶劑，並與 Class 1/2/3 限度比對
blocks.en: Residual solvents (ICH Q3C): all solvents used in the synthesis steps must be listed and compared against the Class 1/2/3 limits

blocks.zh: 元素雜質（ICH Q3D）：需提供風險評估報告，說明哪些元素可能引入（催化劑殘留、設備浸出）
blocks.en: Elemental impurities (ICH Q3D): a risk assessment report is needed, explaining which elements may be introduced (catalyst residues, equipment leaching)

blocks.zh: 參考標準的實務建議
blocks.en: Practical Advice on Reference Standards

blocks.zh: Phase 1 時，CDMO 通常以一批經完整表徵的 API 批次作為 Working Reference Standard，需提供：鑑別（NMR、IR、MS）、純度（HPLC）、含量、及外觀數據。此標準應附有 COA 並經 QA 正式批准。Phase 3 前，應考慮是否需要建立 Primary Reference Standard 並存入長期穩定保存計畫。
blocks.en: In Phase 1, a CDMO usually uses one fully characterized API batch as the Working Reference Standard, and must provide identification (NMR, IR, MS), purity (HPLC), assay and appearance data. The standard should have a COA and be formally approved by QA. Before Phase 3, consider whether a Primary Reference Standard needs to be established and placed in the long-term stability program.

blocks.zh: 2.3 Drug Product CMC Requirements — §312.23(a)(7)(ii) 製劑 CMC 要求
blocks.en: 2.3 Drug Product CMC Requirements - §312.23(a)(7)(ii)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：製劑 CMC 的雙層控制邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two-Tier Control Logic of Drug Product CMC

blocks.zh: 製劑 CMC 涵蓋兩個層次的控制：
blocks.en: Drug product CMC covers two levels of control:

blocks.zh: 製程中控制（In-Process Controls, IPC）：填充重量、pH 確認、溶液澄清度——在製造過程中即時監控，防止問題品到達最終放行階段
blocks.en: In-Process Controls (IPC): fill weight, pH confirmation and solution clarity, monitored in real time during manufacture to keep problem product from reaching final release

blocks.zh: 最終放行規格（Release Specifications）：批次放行前執行的全套測試，結果需在 COA 上呈現並由 QP/QA 簽署放行
blocks.en: Release Specifications: the full set of tests performed before batch release, with results presented on the COA and the release signed off by the QP/QA

blocks.zh: 對 FDA 而言，兩層控制都必須在 CMC 章節中描述。Phase 1 時 IPC 可較簡略，但無菌保證相關的測試（無菌試驗、內毒素、微粒）從一開始就必須完整執行，沒有「Phase-Appropriate 豁免」。
blocks.en: FDA requires both levels of control to be described in the CMC section. In Phase 1 the IPC can be simpler, but the tests related to sterility assurance (sterility test, endotoxin, particulates) must be performed in full from the start; there is no "phase-appropriate waiver" for them.

blocks.zh: 末端滅菌 vs. 非同步無菌製程的法規選擇
blocks.en: Regulatory Choice: Terminal Sterilization vs. Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: FDA 的立場（1987 Guidance + 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance）：末端滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）是首選，因為無菌保證水準（SAL = 10⁻⁶）高於非同步無菌製程。若藥物無法耐受末端滅菌（熱敏感、輻射敏感），才使用非同步無菌製程（Aseptic Processing）。在 CMC 章節中，必須明確說明採用哪種方法，並提供合理性說明。
blocks.en: FDA's position (1987 Guidance + 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance): terminal sterilization is preferred, because its sterility assurance level (SAL = 10⁻⁶) is higher than that of aseptic processing. Aseptic processing is used only if the drug cannot tolerate terminal sterilization (heat sensitive, radiation sensitive). The CMC section must state clearly which method is used and provide a justification.

blocks.zh: FDA 483 高風險：Media Fill 資料
blocks.en: FDA 483 High Risk: Media Fill Data

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時，Media Fill（培養基模擬灌裝）結果是最常被要求的文件之一。CMC 章節應包含最近一次 Media Fill 的摘要（日期、批量、結果、EM 結果）。若 CDMO 的 Media Fill 紀錄與 IND 中描述的設施不一致，可能觸發 Data Integrity 警告或 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, Media Fill (simulated filling with growth medium) results are among the most frequently requested documents. The CMC section should include a summary of the most recent Media Fill (date, batch size, results, EM results). If the CDMO's Media Fill records are inconsistent with the facility described in the IND, this may trigger a Data Integrity citation or a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: USP <788> vs. <789> 的區別
blocks.en: The Difference Between USP <788> and <789>

blocks.zh: 兩者都是微粒測試，但應用範圍不同：
blocks.en: Both are particulate tests, but they apply to different scopes:

blocks.zh: USP <788> Particulate Matter in Injections：適用於大容量注射劑（LVP, ≥100 mL）及非靜脈注射品；限度較寬
blocks.en: USP <788> Particulate Matter in Injections: applies to large-volume injections (LVP, ≥100 mL) and non-intravenous injectable products; the limits are looser

blocks.zh: USP <789> Particulate Matter in Ophthalmic Solutions：適用於眼用注射劑；限度更嚴格
blocks.en: USP <789> Particulate Matter in Ophthalmic Solutions: applies to ophthalmic injectables; the limits are stricter

blocks.zh: 小容量注射劑（SVP, <100 mL）適用 USP <788> 中的 SVP 限度標準
blocks.en: Small-volume injections (SVP, <100 mL) are subject to the SVP limit criteria in USP <788>

blocks.zh: 蛋白質製劑另需依 USP <787>（亞可見微粒）或 MFI（流動影像）評估蛋白質聚集體。
blocks.en: Protein formulations additionally need protein aggregates evaluated under USP <787> (subvisible particles) or by MFI (micro-flow imaging).

blocks.zh: 2.4 Phase-Appropriate CMC Depth 臨床階段適應性 CMC 深度
blocks.en: 2.4 Phase-Appropriate CMC Depth

blocks.zh: 比喻：CMC 是從家庭食譜到工廠配方的演進
blocks.en: Analogy: CMC Evolves from a Home Recipe to a Factory Formula

blocks.zh: Phase 1 = 粗略的家庭食譜：知道主要食材和大致步驟，能做出一道菜（安全的藥）就夠了。不需要克數精確到小數點、不需要通過 ISO 認證的廚房。
blocks.en: Phase 1 = a rough home recipe: you know the main ingredients and the general steps, and it is enough to make one dish (a safe drug). You do not need grams measured to the decimal point or an ISO-certified kitchen.

blocks.zh: Phase 2 = 開始標準化的小餐廳食譜：每次做出來的口感要一致，開始記錄時間/溫度/比例。客人更多了，品質控制變得重要。
blocks.en: Phase 2 = a standardized small-restaurant recipe: the taste must be consistent every time, and you begin recording time/temperature/proportions. With more customers, quality control becomes important.

blocks.zh: Phase 3 = 工業化的標準作業程序（SOP）：每個步驟都有驗證數據，廚師換了也能做出完全一樣的產品。這是 NDA/BLA 申請的前哨站——FDA 會來「查廚房」（PAI）。
blocks.en: Phase 3 = an industrialized standard operating procedure (SOP): every step has validation data, and even if the cook changes, the product comes out exactly the same. This is the outpost before the NDA/BLA application: FDA will come to "inspect the kitchen" (PAI).

blocks.zh: 關鍵：Phase-Appropriate 不代表 Phase 1 可以品質差，而是某些文件深度（驗證報告、統計設計）可以與階段相稱。無菌保證、患者安全相關測試從第一天就要全面執行。
blocks.en: Key point: Phase-appropriate does not mean Phase 1 may be of poor quality; it means only that certain depths of documentation (validation reports, statistical design) can be matched to the phase. Sterility assurance and patient-safety-related tests must be performed in full from day one.

blocks.zh: 公式：CMC 深度 = f(Phase × Risk)
blocks.en: Formula: CMC Depth = f(Phase × Risk)

blocks.zh: 風險越高（慢性給藥、脆弱族群、高劑量），CMC 文件的深度要求越接近商業申請水準。FDA 審查官在評估 CMC 充分性時，會同時考量臨床方案的風險設計（Phase × Risk 矩陣）。
blocks.en: The higher the risk (chronic dosing, vulnerable populations, high doses), the closer the required depth of CMC documentation comes to the level of a commercial application. When assessing the adequacy of CMC, FDA reviewers also consider the risk design of the clinical protocol (the Phase × Risk matrix).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的實務注意：Phase 1 GMP 的灰色地帶
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Note: The Gray Area of Phase 1 GMP

blocks.zh: FDA 2008 指引《CGMP for Phase 1 Investigational Drugs》明確指出，Phase 1 的 GMP 要求可「適當調整」，但以下事項沒有例外：
blocks.en: FDA's 2008 guidance "CGMP for Phase 1 Investigational Drugs" states clearly that GMP requirements for Phase 1 may be "appropriately adjusted", but the following have no exceptions:

blocks.zh: 完整批次記錄（Batch Production Records）
blocks.en: Complete batch production records

blocks.zh: 完整放行測試（包含無菌、內毒素、含量）
blocks.en: Complete release testing (including sterility, endotoxin and assay)

blocks.zh: QA 的書面批次放行授權
blocks.en: Written batch release authorization by QA

blocks.zh: OOS（規格外結果）調查程序
blocks.en: OOS (out-of-specification result) investigation procedures

blocks.zh: SOP 文件體系
blocks.en: An SOP documentation system

blocks.zh: Phase 1 可簡化的是：廠房驗證深度、分析方法的全面驗證程度、年度產品回顧的正式程度。
blocks.en: What can be simplified in Phase 1: the depth of facility validation, the extent of full validation of analytical methods, and the formality of the annual product review.

blocks.zh: 2.5 IND Amendments for CMC Changes IND CMC 修訂申報類型
blocks.en: 2.5 IND Amendments for CMC Changes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：變更分類決策樹
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Decision Tree for Classifying Changes

blocks.zh: 面對任何 CMC 變更，CDMO 和 Sponsor 應依以下邏輯分類：
blocks.en: For any CMC change, the CDMO and Sponsor should classify it using the following logic:

blocks.zh: 此變更是否影響患者安全？（安全性直接相關）→ 是：Protocol Amendment（等 30 天）
blocks.en: Does the change affect patient safety? (directly safety-related) → Yes: Protocol Amendment (wait 30 days)

blocks.zh: 此變更是重大的新 CMC 資訊，但不影響安全？ → 是：Information Amendment（30 天內提交，可先執行）
blocks.en: Is the change significant new CMC information, but without a safety impact? → Yes: Information Amendment (submit within 30 days; may be implemented first)

blocks.zh: 此變更是否為小幅改進，不影響品質或安全？ → 是：Annual Report 彙整
blocks.en: Is the change a minor improvement that does not affect quality or safety? → Yes: include in the Annual Report

blocks.zh: 分類模糊時，應諮詢 FDA（Pre-IND meeting 或 Type B meeting）以避免在沒有取得 FDA 認可的情況下執行重大變更。
blocks.en: When the classification is unclear, consult FDA (a Pre-IND meeting or Type B meeting) to avoid implementing a major change without FDA's concurrence.

blocks.zh: 情境應用：CDMO 場地變更的申報義務
blocks.en: Scenario: Reporting Obligations for a CDMO Site Change

blocks.zh: 場景：Sponsor 的 Phase 2 試驗進行中，決定將製劑灌裝場地從 CDMO-A（美國）遷移至 CDMO-B（新加坡）。
blocks.en: Scenario: During the Sponsor's Phase 2 trial, it decides to move drug product filling from CDMO-A (US) to CDMO-B (Singapore).

blocks.zh: 需要什麼？
blocks.en: What is needed?

blocks.zh: 製造場地變更屬於重大變更 → 以 Information Amendment 提交（假設製程不變，安全無疑慮）
blocks.en: A manufacturing site change is a significant change → submit as an Information Amendment (assuming the process is unchanged and there are no safety concerns)

blocks.zh: 若製程同時有調整（如更換滅菌方式）→ 可能需要 Protocol Amendment
blocks.en: If the process is also adjusted (for example, a change of sterilization method) → a Protocol Amendment may be needed

blocks.zh: CDMO-B 需提供：廠址資訊（名稱、地址、FEI 號）、設施描述、近期 Media Fill 紀錄摘要、EM 資料
blocks.en: CDMO-B must provide: site information (name, address, FEI number), a facility description, a summary of recent Media Fill records, and EM data

blocks.zh: CDMO-B 必須在 FDA Drug Establishment Registration 完成登記
blocks.en: CDMO-B must be registered under FDA Drug Establishment Registration

blocks.zh: 風險：若未提交 Amendment 即開始在 CDMO-B 製造，臨床批次等同於在未核准場地生產，可觸發 §312.70 臨床試驗終止。
blocks.en: Risk: if manufacturing begins at CDMO-B without submitting an Amendment, the clinical batches are effectively produced at an unapproved site, which can trigger termination of the clinical trial under §312.70.

blocks.zh: 年度報告 vs. 立即申報的界線
blocks.en: The Line Between the Annual Report and Immediate Submission

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO/Sponsor 的常見錯誤：將「應立即提交的 Information Amendment」誤歸為「可等年度報告」的小變更。原則：任何可能影響批次間一致性的製程調整，都不應等到年度報告才通知 FDA。穩妥做法是建立內部 CMC Change Control 機制，每個變更先評估申報類型，再執行。
blocks.en: A common mistake among many CDMOs/Sponsors: treating an "Information Amendment that should be submitted immediately" as a minor change that "can wait for the annual report". The principle: any process adjustment that may affect batch-to-batch consistency should not wait until the annual report to be notified to FDA. The prudent approach is to set up an internal CMC Change Control mechanism that assesses the submission type of every change before it is implemented.

blocks.zh: 2.6 Sterile Injectables: Additional CMC Requirements 無菌注射劑：額外 CMC 要求
blocks.en: 2.6 Sterile Injectables: Additional CMC Requirements

blocks.zh: 公式：內毒素限度計算 K/M
blocks.en: Formula: Endotoxin Limit Calculation K/M

blocks.zh:
內毒素限度（EL）= K ÷ M

K = 閾值常數（靜脈注射 = 5 EU/kg/hr）
M = 最大給藥量（每公斤體重每小時最大劑量，單位 mL/kg/hr 或 mg/kg/hr）

範例計算：
  藥品：蛋白質注射劑，IV，最大劑量 10 mL/hr，體重 70 kg
  M = 10 mL ÷ 70 kg ÷ 1 hr ≈ 0.143 mL/kg/hr
  EL = 5 EU/kg/hr ÷ 0.143 mL/kg/hr ≈ 35 EU/mL

若藥品標示濃度為 1 mg/mL，則規格為 ≤35 EU/mg（或 ≤35 EU/mL）

注意：鞘內（intrathecal）給藥 K = 0.2 EU/kg/hr，限度更嚴
blocks.en:
Endotoxin Limit (EL) = K ÷ M

K = threshold constant (intravenous = 5 EU/kg/hr)
M = maximum dose (maximum dose per kg body weight per hour, in mL/kg/hr or mg/kg/hr)

Worked example:
  Product: protein injection, IV, maximum dose 10 mL/hr, body weight 70 kg
  M = 10 mL ÷ 70 kg ÷ 1 hr ≈ 0.143 mL/kg/hr
  EL = 5 EU/kg/hr ÷ 0.143 mL/kg/hr ≈ 35 EU/mL

If the labeled concentration of the product is 1 mg/mL, the specification is ≤35 EU/mg (or ≤35 EU/mL)

Note: for intrathecal administration K = 0.2 EU/kg/hr, so the limit is stricter

blocks.zh: CDMO 需確保 LAL 試驗已針對該藥品基質進行干擾測試（inhibition/enhancement test），且每批次 LAL 試驗記錄完整歸檔。
blocks.en: The CDMO must ensure that the LAL test has been subjected to interference testing (inhibition/enhancement test) for the drug matrix, and that the LAL test records for every batch are completely filed.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程模擬（Media Fill）的合規要求
blocks.en: Compliance Requirements for Aseptic Process Simulation (Media Fill)

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance 及 EU GMP Annex 1（2022）均要求：
blocks.en: Both the FDA 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance and EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) require:

blocks.zh: 每個無菌灌裝線每 6 個月執行一次 Media Fill
blocks.en: A Media Fill every 6 months for each aseptic filling line

blocks.zh: 每次模擬批量應代表正常商業批量，最少 5,000 單位（針對低污染率評估）
blocks.en: Each simulation batch size should represent a normal commercial batch size, with a minimum of 5,000 units (for assessing a low contamination rate)

blocks.zh: 合格標準：0 污染單位為目標；超過 0.1% 污染率視為一律不合格，需完整調查
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: the target is 0 contaminated units; a contamination rate above 0.1% is regarded as an automatic failure and requires a full investigation

blocks.zh: Media Fill 失敗是高風險事件，可能觸發 FDA Warning Letter
blocks.en: A Media Fill failure is a high-risk event and may trigger an FDA Warning Letter

blocks.zh: 在 IND CMC 中，需提供至少一次近期 Media Fill 的摘要資訊（非完整報告），包括日期、規模、結果。
blocks.en: In the IND CMC, summary information (not the full report) of at least one recent Media Fill must be provided, including date, scale and results.

blocks.zh: E&L：Phase 1 的合規最低門檻
blocks.en: E&L: The Minimum Compliance Threshold for Phase 1

blocks.zh: 很多小型生技公司在 Phase 1 IND 時提交不完整的 E&L 資料，FDA 通常接受以下 Phase 1 最低要求：
blocks.en: Many small biotech companies submit incomplete E&L data in a Phase 1 IND. FDA usually accepts the following as the Phase 1 minimum:

blocks.zh: 提供容器/封口的供應商 Extractables 研究報告摘要（通常由容器供應商提供）
blocks.en: A summary of the supplier's Extractables study report for the container/closure (usually provided by the container supplier)

blocks.zh: 書面風險評估：說明為何現階段 Leachables 資料尚不完整，以及何時計畫完成
blocks.en: A written risk assessment: explaining why the Leachables data are not yet complete at this stage and when completion is planned

blocks.zh: 確認使用材料符合 USP <661> / USP <87> / ISO 10993 等相關生物相容性標準
blocks.en: Confirmation that the materials used meet relevant biocompatibility standards such as USP <661> / USP <87> / ISO 10993

blocks.zh: Phase 3 前若仍無法提供 Leachables 資料，FDA 可能在 Pre-NDA meeting 中要求補充，成為 NDA 申請的瓶頸。
blocks.en: If Leachables data still cannot be provided before Phase 3, FDA may ask for supplementary data at the Pre-NDA meeting, which becomes a bottleneck for the NDA submission.

blocks.zh: 2.7 FDA Right to Inspect Manufacturing Sites FDA 對製造場地的查廠權利
blocks.en: 2.7 FDA Right to Inspect Manufacturing Sites

blocks.zh: CDMO 在 IND 體系中的查廠法律地位
blocks.en: The Legal Position of a CDMO in the IND System for Inspections

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常不是 IND 的持有者（Sponsor），但一旦列名於 CMC 章節，即受 FDA 轄管。具體法律依據：
blocks.en: A CDMO is usually not the IND holder (Sponsor), but once it is named in the CMC section it falls under FDA jurisdiction. The specific legal bases are:

blocks.zh: FD&C Act §704：FDA 有權進入任何從事藥品製造、加工、包裝、持有的場所進行查驗
blocks.en: FD&C Act §704: FDA has the authority to enter and inspect any establishment where drugs are manufactured, processed, packed or held

blocks.zh: §312.68：FDA 可要求 Sponsor 提供或允許 FDA 直接查閱 IND 相關記錄
blocks.en: §312.68: FDA may require the Sponsor to provide, or to permit FDA direct access to, IND-related records

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211（CGMP）：CDMO 必須遵守 CGMP，無論其客戶（Sponsor）是否持有 IND
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 (CGMP): a CDMO must comply with CGMP, whether or not its client (the Sponsor) holds an IND

blocks.zh: 實務上，FDA 查廠通報（Form FDA 483 Observations）和 Warning Letter 都是直接開給 CDMO，而非開給 Sponsor。CDMO 的合規問題由 CDMO 自行承擔法律後果。
blocks.en: In practice, FDA inspection findings (Form FDA 483 Observations) and Warning Letters are issued directly to the CDMO, not to the Sponsor. The CDMO bears the legal consequences of its own compliance problems.

blocks.zh: 練習題：CMC 項目分類
blocks.en: Exercise: Classifying CMC Items

blocks.zh: 請將以下 10 個項目分類為：
blocks.en: Classify the following 10 items as:

blocks.zh: (A) 原料藥 CMC   (B) 製劑 CMC   (C) 兩者皆涵蓋   (D) 不屬於 CMC 範疇
blocks.en: (A) Drug Substance CMC   (B) Drug Product CMC   (C) Covered by both   (D) Not within the scope of CMC

blocks.zh: 合成路徑描述（含中間體）
blocks.en: Description of the synthetic route (including intermediates)

blocks.zh: LAL 內毒素試驗結果
blocks.en: LAL endotoxin test results

blocks.zh: 賦形劑的定量配方與功能
blocks.en: Quantitative formula and function of excipients

blocks.zh: API 的 X 射線晶體結構（多晶型鑑定）
blocks.en: X-ray crystal structure of the API (polymorph identification)

blocks.zh: ICH Q1A 穩定性研究報告
blocks.en: ICH Q1A stability study report

blocks.zh: 培養基模擬灌裝結果
blocks.en: Media fill results

blocks.zh: 臨床研究者手冊（Investigator's Brochure）
blocks.en: Investigator's Brochure

blocks.zh: 容器封口完整性測試方法
blocks.en: Container closure integrity test method

blocks.zh: 毒理學動物試驗資料
blocks.en: Toxicology animal study data

blocks.zh: USP <71> 無菌試驗結果
blocks.en: USP <71> sterility test results

blocks.zh: 參考答案：1=A, 2=B, 3=B, 4=A, 5=C（原料藥與製劑各有穩定性計畫）, 6=B, 7=D（屬於 §312.23(a)(5)，藥理毒理或 IB 章節）, 8=B, 9=D（屬於 §312.23(a)(8) 藥理毒理章節）, 10=B
blocks.en: Reference answers: 1=A, 2=B, 3=B, 4=A, 5=C (the drug substance and drug product each have their own stability program), 6=B, 7=D (falls under §312.23(a)(5), the pharmacology/toxicology or IB section), 8=B, 9=D (falls under §312.23(a)(8), the pharmacology/toxicology section), 10=B

blocks.zh: FDA 483 風險：IND CMC 與實際製造脫節
blocks.en: FDA 483 Risk: IND CMC Disconnected from Actual Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 最常見的 IND CMC 合規問題之一：IND 中描述的製造方法（例如「使用 X 品牌 0.22 µm 過濾器」），與 CDMO 實際批次記錄（使用 Y 品牌過濾器）不一致。此類差異雖看似微小，在 FDA 查廠時屬於 Data Integrity 紅旗。CDMO 應建立機制，確保 IND 中記載的製造描述隨製程變更同步更新，並由 Sponsor 提交相應 Amendment。
blocks.en: One of the most common IND CMC compliance problems: the manufacturing method described in the IND (for example "use a brand X 0.22 µm filter") is inconsistent with the CDMO's actual batch records (a brand Y filter was used). Although such a difference seems minor, during an FDA inspection it is a Data Integrity red flag. The CDMO should establish a mechanism to ensure that the manufacturing description in the IND is updated in step with process changes, and that the Sponsor submits the corresponding Amendment.

blocks.zh: 章節摘要 Section Summary (中文)
blocks.en: Section Summary (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋 §312.23(a)(7) 規定的 IND CMC 要求，重點聚焦無菌注射劑與 CDMO 的合規文件責任。
blocks.en: This section covers the IND CMC requirements in §312.23(a)(7), focusing on sterile injectables and the CDMO's responsibility for compliance documentation.

blocks.zh: IND 結構：§312.23(a) 規定 10 大元素；CMC（元素 7）是 CDMO 對 IND 的核心貢獻，也是 FDA 初始安全性審查的重點目標。
blocks.en: IND structure: §312.23(a) specifies 10 elements; CMC (element 7) is the CDMO's core contribution to the IND and also a main target of FDA's initial safety review.

blocks.zh: 原料藥 CMC：7 項必要元素——描述、製造商、製備方法、管制（鑑別/純度/效價/含量測定）、參考標準、容器封口、穩定性。
blocks.en: Drug substance CMC: 7 required elements: description, manufacturer, method of preparation, controls (identity/purity/potency/assay), reference standard, container closure and stability.

blocks.zh: 製劑 CMC：定量配方（含賦形劑功能）、製造商、製造方法（含滅菌方式）、放行規格、容器封口、及無菌相關數據（Media Fill、EM、內毒素、微粒、CCI）。
blocks.en: Drug product CMC: quantitative formula (including excipient functions), manufacturer, manufacturing method (including sterilization method), release specifications, container closure, and sterility-related data (Media Fill, EM, endotoxin, particulates, CCI).

blocks.zh: Phase 適應性深度：製程描述、規格、穩定性、方法驗證、製程驗證的文件深度隨臨床階段與患者風險遞增；無菌保證要求從 Phase 1 起即不得妥協。
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate depth: the depth of documentation for process description, specifications, stability, method validation and process validation rises with the clinical phase and patient risk; sterility assurance requirements must not be compromised from Phase 1 onward.

blocks.zh: CMC 修訂：Protocol Amendment（§312.30）適用於影響受試者安全的變更（等 30 天）；Information Amendment（§312.31）適用於重大 CMC 資訊更新（30 天內提交，可先執行）；年度報告（§312.33）彙整小型累積變更。
blocks.en: CMC amendments: a Protocol Amendment (§312.30) applies to changes affecting subject safety (wait 30 days); an Information Amendment (§312.31) applies to significant CMC information updates (submit within 30 days; may be implemented first); the Annual Report (§312.33) compiles minor cumulative changes.

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑：EL = K/M（K = 5 EU/kg/hr 靜脈）；CCI；無菌製程模擬；E&L（Phase 1 可提供初步資料，Phase 3 前須完成完整研究）。
blocks.en: Sterile injectables: EL = K/M (K = 5 EU/kg/hr for intravenous); CCI; aseptic process simulation; E&L (preliminary data are acceptable in Phase 1, but a full study must be completed before Phase 3).

blocks.zh: 查廠義務：CMC 章節列名的所有場地均受 FDA 查廠管轄；CDMO 須維護記錄、配合查廠、並向 Sponsor 通報重大偏差。
blocks.en: Inspection obligations: all sites named in the CMC section are subject to FDA inspection; the CDMO must maintain records, cooperate with inspections and report significant deviations to the Sponsor.
